mapper.insert: insert into ai_qa_history (user_id, user_name, module, question, answer, sources_json, retrieval_mode, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{module}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{sourcesJson}, #{retrievalMode}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_qa_history where create_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01')
